# Baibhab Resorts & Conventions

> Official website and knowledge base for Baibhab Resorts & Conventions, Phulnakhara, Bhubaneswar–Cuttack Highway (NH-16), Odisha, India. Premium accommodations, banquet halls, open lawns, multi-cuisine dining, and corporate event venues.

## Overview

Baibhab Resorts & Conventions is a premier hospitality, wedding, and convention destination situated directly on National Highway 16 near the Phulnakhara Flyover (also known locally as Nakhara). Serving as the exact midpoint between Odisha's twin cities—Bhubaneswar (15 km) and Cuttack (16 km)—the resort eliminates inner-city traffic delays for guests and delegates. The property features comfortable rooms, column-free indoor banquet halls, sprawling outdoor lawns, multi-cuisine dining, and secure parking for 200+ vehicles.

- **Address**: Near Phulnakhara Flyover, Bhubaneswar–Cuttack Highway (NH-16), Khordha, Odisha, India
- **Phone / Reservations**: +91 9938875749
- **WhatsApp**: +91 9938875749
- **Email**: baibhabresorts@gmail.com
- **Official Website**: https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com
- **Online Booking Engine**: https://bookone.io/Baibhab-Conventions-Resorts?bookingEngine=true
- **Check-in Time**: 14:00 (24-hour reception)
- **Check-out Time**: 12:00

## Key Pages & Services

- [Home](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/): Overview of resort services, guest testimonials, venue highlights, and instant booking options.
- [Stay & Accommodations](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/stay): Details on room categories, complimentary breakfast, high-speed Wi-Fi, and amenities.
  - [Premium Room](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/stay/premium-room): King-size bed, work desk, private bathroom, AC, TV, electric kettle, and room service.
  - [Deluxe Room](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/stay/deluxe-room): Comfortable double bed, air conditioning, modern bathroom, and dedicated workspace.
- [Venues & Capacity](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/events/venues): Banquet halls and outdoor spaces with seating capacities, dimensions, and floor layouts.
  - **Royal Imperial Hall**: 5,000 sq. ft. indoor banquet hall, 22-foot column-free ceiling, in-built LED wall, stage, and bridal suites. Capacity: 350 seated, 500 floating.
  - **Grand Green Lawn**: 8,000 sq. ft. manicured open-air lawn for grand weddings, exhibitions, and cultural functions. Capacity: 500 seated, 800+ floating. Weather-backup indoor hall guarantee included.
  - **Mangal Mini Hall**: 1,500 sq. ft. intimate banquet space for Haldi, Mehendi, birthday parties, and seminars. Capacity: 60 seated, 100 floating.
  - **Executive Boardroom**: 800 sq. ft. meeting space for corporate presentations, board meetings, and interviews. Capacity: 25 seated, 35 floating.
- [Weddings & Celebrations](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/events/weddings): Tailored wedding packages, decor planning, dedicated bridal dressing suites, and pure-vegetarian or multi-cuisine banquet catering.
- [Corporate & MICE](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/events/corporate): High-tech audio-visual support, high-lumen projection, 100% full power backup, high-speed Wi-Fi, and executive business dining.
- [Dining & Restaurant](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/dining): Multi-cuisine restaurant (Fusion Bites / Baibhab Kitchen) serving authentic Odia specialties, North/South Indian dishes, and Continental cuisine.
  - [Baibhab Kitchen](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/dining/baibhab-kitchen): Kitchen operations, live counters, and catering capabilities for large events.
- [Location & Directions](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/location): Highway navigation, landmark distances, and twin-city connectivity details.
  - SUM Hospital 2: 1 km
  - DPS Kalinga & EAST College: 3 km
  - Bhubaneswar Railway Station: 15 km
  - Cuttack Railway Station: 16 km
  - Biju Patnaik International Airport (BBI): 18 km (~30–35 min drive)
- [Amenities](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/amenities): Comprehensive facility list including 200+ car parking, 24/7 power backup, high-speed Wi-Fi, elevator access, round-the-clock security, and driver rest areas.
- [Offers & Packages](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/offers): Bundled wedding packages, corporate day-delegate rates, and seasonal stay promotions.
- [Photo & Video Gallery](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/gallery): Photo showcase of rooms, night courtyard, daytime gardens, wedding decorations, and dining spaces.
- [Contact & Inquiries](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/contact): Direct proposal request forms for banquet bookings, weddings, room reservations, and directions.
- [Resort Blog](https://baibhabresortsandconventions.com/blog): Travel articles, local attraction guides, event planning advice, and medical stay guides near SUM Hospital 2.
